description: Nova Scotia Road Network (NSRN) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. The Nova Scotia Road Network (NSRN) is the authoritative source for road centerlines in the province. This 3D coverage contains addressed roads and non-addressed roads and has several descriptive attributes to define a roadway such as number of lanes, surface type, and road class. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Its tags are road, local, track, dry weather, nsrn. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
